review: Completed source-pixel repair for all four Goodyear Tower plan sheets plus the architect base inset used by the model. Long original circular and masonry-boundary traces plus source-resolved member profiles are walls. Original radial tread edges, long stair arcs, dashed transition flights and sheet 5 masonry hatching are flat detail. Sheet 3 preserves 26 visually resolvable column profiles and leaves four annotation-obscured or ambiguous positions blank; sheet 5 preserves 30 independently detected profiles at their actual source shapes and radii. Upper masonry is not filled. Every semantic pixel is present in its original scan threshold; no ideal circle, standardized member, contour fill, wall closure or inferred floor slab is drawn. The two first-gallery labels on consecutive Goodyear sheets are duplicate representations of one physical level, so no vertical link is asserted between them. The architect inset's outer radial ring has no printed legend that proves the guide stop's exterior-arcade position; that place and binding are removed.
limitations: 模型包含一张现行建筑师基座图与四张1910年分组实测图；五张图是来源平面组，不代表八个实际楼层均有独立完整楼板平面。
连续两张实测图都表示第一层回廊平台，属于同一物理层的重复来源表达，故不生成跨图楼梯连接。
螺旋梯入口与钟层已有平面依据；入口浮雕、外部柱廊停点的精确地面锚点及顶部环台仍缺少可核验平面，保持未绑定。
四张实测图只保留原扫描中经分类的墙、柱、踏步与砌体排线像素；第一至第三层图有四处柱位被注记遮挡或候选不明确，保持留空；不补圆、不统一柱尺寸、不闭合墙线，也不凭空补楼板或填实砌体。
历史测绘与建筑方案不证明当前开放、安保、无障碍或单向通行状态。

sourceProjection.basis: Page 3 contains the visually reviewed source drawing from which the primary one-page audit mask was derived. It is stored for provenance, while no floor is extracted directly from this supplementary record.

The official technical publication was inspected for the eight-floor inventory and bell-chamber identification. It supplies no floor used by the model, so its illustrations are not converted into plans.

Brooklyn Museum Goodyear measurement sheet 2 was visually checked as a direct overhead stair projection. This v5 semantic raster contains only classified original scan pixels for the concentric masonry faces, repeated exterior profiles, spiral treads and the dashed first-gallery transition; it contains no redrawn circles, closed walls or text geometry.

Brooklyn Museum Goodyear measurement sheet 3 was visually checked as a direct overhead stair projection. This v6 semantic raster contains only classified original scan pixels for long concentric wall traces, 26 unambiguous source-resolved column profiles, spiral treads and the explicit right-side dashed flight. Four annotation-obscured member positions are omitted rather than reconstructed.

Brooklyn Museum Goodyear measurement sheet 4 was visually checked as a direct overhead projection. This v4 semantic raster contains only classified pixels from the original scan: source circular wall traces, source column ink and source stair-edge ink. It contains no redrawn circles, standardized column shapes or filled masonry regions.

Brooklyn Museum Goodyear measurement sheet 5 was visually checked as a direct overhead upper plan. This v7 semantic raster contains only classified original scan pixels for long wall boundaries, 30 source-detected outer profiles, two stair sequences, the small circular stair and masonry hatching. Hatch lines remain flat detail; no masonry area, missing slab or replacement geometry is filled.
The complete Brooklyn Museum source scan is retained for audit of the margin crop and ink threshold; the model floor selects its deterministic one-page derived mask instead.
